question_text: Function outcomes(box) returns ten Boolean results for one game. Supplied make_box() returns a newly shuffled permutation for each call. Construct win_percentage(make_box, trials=10000), for positive integer trials, returning the percentage of games in which all ten results are True. You may use all().
